changed_by.title: chore: bring in the second model and the public repo skill

lesson.summary: The first retro run after #685 did what the pull request claimed: with no AGENT_MODEL_FALLBACK variable set, its env gave the second model as claude-opus-5-5, and nothing needs changing.
lesson.detail: Pull request #685 changed one line in `factory/workflows/retro.yml`: `AGENT_MODEL_FALLBACK` now falls back to `claude-opus-5-5` when the repository sets no variable. Before, it was empty. Retro run 45173360070 logged `AGENT_MODEL_FALLBACK: claude-opus-5-5` in every step. The earlier CI and review runs for #685, quoted in this run's facts, still showed it empty. The diff touched no step, so `changed_steps` is empty. The usage-limit check found no limit, so the retro ran on its first model, claude-opus-5-5, and finished in 46 seconds for $0.60. No limit was in force, so the switch to the second model was not used. The change itself is only the default value, and that value took effect.

cost.amount: nothing: the retro completed in 46 seconds for $0.60, as intended

lesson.saves: nothing: there was no fault to prevent
